prompt: Draft a rebalance recommendation that balances target drift, liquidity cost, restricted-list checks, and scenario downside.

args.name: Rebalance & Scenario Lab Note
args.data: Recommendation: hold execution and revise the rebalance to address the larger absolute target-drift change of -0.0431 on the 0.0865 weight before the -0.0114 change on the 0.0471 weight. Liquidity-impact scores are 80.62 and 10.55, so the higher-cost row should be mapped to its proposed trade and resized first; the rows do not provide cost units or that trade mapping. The restricted-list check remains Open at 31.12 and must be cleared at security level before any trade is released. Scenario values decline from 76.82 to 65.22 and then rebound to 68.04 in the retrieved series, so the revised trade set needs a documented downside limit. Approve execution only after the larger drift is addressed, the 80.62 liquidity-impact row is resized, the restriction is cleared, and the scenario trough is within tolerance.
